message: 酔いどれて、パンダ

name: Helena
message: 「'Nothing beats a drink after work, right kid?'」

name: Paqy
message: 「I just don't get it...」

name: Helena
message: 「What's with the long face? Haven't had enough to drink yet?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Listen to me, BOSS. It's the golden opportunity to get close to the girl I like, y'know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「So why the hell am I always the one getting left out!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Aah~~. That's rough~~. Well, just drink up」

name: Paqy
message: 「Y-Yeah!」

name: Helena
message: 「'Don't hold back. Today's on me'」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gulp, gulp, pwaaah!!」

name: Helena
message: 「My, you sure can put it away. Chugging McBrayer that survived Prohibition like that」

name: Paqy
message: 「You mean The Untouchables? Another round!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey. Just take the plunge and push that girl down!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Push her down...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Men have guts, women have charm. And pandas are the strongest.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ooh, the strongest!! Leave it to the great me!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu... Things are getting interesting. Come on, drink up\s04」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gulp, gulp. ...Hic.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, I'm gonna do this!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Drink up!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... what is it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, nothing really... I just had a slightly weird feeling」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, really」

name: Ria
message: 「Ms. Ria's Open-Air Classroom~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Unfortunately, today is the final session\s06」

name: Everyone
message: 「Ehhhhh~」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks, everyone\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then today, let's go straight to the ultimate secret technique!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~. Actually, there's not really much left for me to teach you\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does that mean we Crusaders are already the strongest!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope, not that. It means you've already gone beyond the scope of what I can teach.」

name: Misa
message: 「Whatever do you mean by that, Big Sister?」

name: Ria
message: 「Remember how we talked about this Re-Crea being bigger than anything we've ever seen before?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... which means there's no telling what might happen.」

name: Ria
message: 「Right. And it's impossible to know what kind of Demons might come to the Human World, either.」

name: Ria
message: 「Against foes like that, past knowledge won't be of any use.」

name: Ria
message: 「From here on out, we all have to learn together through real combat.」
The end is just the beginning. The truly grueling part is the real thing after this training is over.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's just like the saying, 'Even a dog walks into a stick if it walks around,' isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「So we're diving straight into the real thing, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then let's go look for some Demons right away!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I see, a patrol.」

name: Synn
message: 「Though it'd be best if we don't run into any.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Our only remaining path is to grow stronger by stepping over the corpses of Mr. Demon!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not quite that much of a bloodbath, though\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whenever we want to see you--」

name: Ria
message: 「Not another word~\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... *hic*, found you, Ria-chan」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!! Talk about a conveniently timed turn of events!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, haven't I seen you somewhere before? Ugh, and you reek of booze」

name: Misa
message: 「So cute, though...\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The color scheme and the way he talks. Judging by Misa's reaction, there's only one guy it could be」

name: Ria
message: 「C-Could it be Pa-chan?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan... Ria-chan... *hic*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To think he would evolve in response to his environment--truly a mystery of Mother Nature」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... Ria-chan... Hehehe... Ria-chan, *hic*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hasn't he devolved?」

name: Synn
message: 「He's gotten weaker. Jeez, drinking booze when you're just a plushie...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hold on a second. This appearance--Mr. Panda, were you actually a Demon!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah!?」
This is bad, they're gonna find out.

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't lump me in with guys who can only say 'Ee'!! I am the Great Sage Paqy-sama, you hear!?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right! Look how adorable he is. There's no way he's a Demon」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn! You're his owner, do something!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay. Anyway, let's calm down, Paqy. Here, drink some water」

name: Paqy
message: 「Shaddup!! Like that's gonna quench my thirst!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「The only one who can soothe my thirst is... *hic*. Ria-chan!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Pa-chan. Why did you turn to alcohol...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's your fault, Ria-chan!! You drive me crazy, Ria-chan... You tighten my chest」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wanting to be free from that pain, I ended up drowning myself in booze......」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Makes no sense」

name: Ria
message: 「Even so, why...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, you see... Yours truly... Yours truly...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Because the great me loves Ria-chan!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?!」
Amazing... Paqy can actually confess...
Speaking of Ria-senpai, she's an honor student with top-notch grades and incredible athletic ability.
The young lady of the Kujou family, who runs this academy. And the former Student Council President!
Even facing someone like Ria-senpai, I can boldly tell her how I feel without flattering her or getting intimidated.

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not happy. I'm not happy at all. A confession made on the spur of alcohol like that--」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not happy about it!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ka-BOOM!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Magnificent! Is this what they call the wisdom of year-end?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wisdom of years」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of my sister...\s04 Now then, poor wounded Paqy, please come right this way\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... If only you had just obeyed like good little kids!」
Paqy, who normally would have been reduced to ash by now, closed the distance to Ria-senpai in a flash.

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaah!!」
Caught completely off guard, Ria-senpai is enveloped by Paqy's eerie power.
Paqy scooped up her unconscious body in his arms.

name: Paqy
message: 「Against the great me, this is child's play!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy! Just what are you planning to do?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm taking little Ria for myself! And she's gonna become a woman completely loyal to the great me!!」
For better or worse, Paqy is still one of the Demons.
If that bit about him being a Great Sage is actually true, brainwashing a human might be child's play for him.

name: Paqy
message: 「See ya!」
Before the words even left my mouth, my hand had already shot out.

name: Synn
message: 「Stop it, Paqy. If you do that, Ria-senpai won't be Ria-senpai anymore」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Kekeke... Like the great me gives a damn!!」

name: Misa
message: 「What a vulgar laugh!! This isn't Paqy-san at all!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't it gonna be bad if we don't stop this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I feel terrible for Panda-san, but we must make him thoroughly reflect on his actions here」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kekeke... Acting like you've already won, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If I lost to the likes of you, I wouldn't be able to face my ancestors!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Underestimate the great me and you're gonna regret it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「He split into clones!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Without Ria-chan around, the Crusaders are total trash. Go play with my doubles!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey! Wait!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kekeke...」

name: Synn
message: 「Tch. First we have to deal with these guys」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not Paqy-san--someone like that isn't cute or anything at all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's teach them a lesson!」
